title: PinGuard
description: PinGuard is a lightweight security plugin that allows players to create a personal PIN code when they join the server. The PIN protects their account from unauthorized access and can be managed by server administrators. Simple, customizable, and effective,
body:
📌 Plugin Description

This plugin allows players to create their own PIN code for extra security.
	•	When a player creates a PIN, they must enter it every time they join the server.
	•	Players can reset or recreate their PIN at any time.
	•	Server administrators can monitor, manage, and reset players’ PINs if needed.

Add an extra layer of protection to your server and keep your community safe! 🔐
